submission.text:
For  the backlog item "Make sandboxed agent-manager runs auto-apply accepted changes by default", the agent only did phases 1 and 2 of the plan. The execution agent recommends splitting up the remaining work. Here was its final handoff when I asked if it completed everything:
"""
No — only Phase 1 and Phase 2 are complete. Roughly **30–40%** of the locked plan shipped. The remaining phases each carry meaningful risk and design decisions.

### What's complete

The seam shape: domain types, the new workspace-sandbox endpoint, validation, audit annotations, schema-version-ready provenance fields, 36 unit tests. Both scenarios build green.

### What's NOT complete (and why each matters)

**Phase 3 — run-executor wiring**. This is the load-bearing piece. Until it lands:
- The new `Provider.ApplyAtRunEnd` seam doesn't exist on the agent-manager side. The HTTP endpoint is reachable but no agent-manager code calls it.
- The legacy `tryAutoApproval` / `autoApprove` / `autoReject` / `autoApproveIfEmpty` path is still the only apply path the run executor knows.
- The legacy `AutoApprove` / `AutoReject` / `DisableAutoApproveIfEmpty` / `RequiresApproval` fields remain (the plan's D2 wholesale removal hasn't happened — I left them as deprecated to keep Phase 1+2 compilable).
- No eager provenance write at sandbox setup.
- No `runOutcome` flowing on apply calls.

**Phase 4 — GC for `manualReview=true` sandboxes**. The `ManualReviewTTL` config knob exists but nothing reads it. Abandoned pending-review sandboxes will leak indefinitely.

**Phase 5 — shared schema-version contract package**. Per D3, this is supposed to land in parallel with `execute/gct-pending-ai-provenance-hardening`. That upstream item appears to be on a different branch and I haven't touched it. The wire-level fields I added (`runOutcome`, `state`, `conversationId`, `costUsd`) are not yet persisted — readers will see empty values until both sides land.

**Phase 6 — six run-executor test cases + GC TTL test**. The plan's headline tests (success-apply, failure-apply, partial-acceptance split, manualReview-deferred, no-op empty-provenance, ConversationID inheritance via run executor, GC auto-deny on TTL expiry). None of these exist yet — Phases 1 and 2 only have unit tests for the new types and validation.

**Phase 7** — package-doc pointer in `run_executor.go`. Trivial; depends on Phase 3.

**Cross-cutting cleanup** I deferred from the plan:
- Proto + generated code (`packages/proto/.../types.proto`, `types.pb.go`) still carry the legacy fields. Plan calls for removal; I'd want to confirm regen tooling first.
- `orchestration/sandbox_config_test.go` fixtures still use the legacy field names.
- Spawn surfaces (web-console, swarm-manager queue, cron, CLI) don't populate `Run.ConversationID` / `Run.ParentRunID` yet — the inheritance fallback covers the gap, but the contract intent is for spawners to set these directly.
- No DB read-time normalization for persisted runs that have `Acceptance.AutoApprove==true` / `RequiresApproval` set (mentioned in the plan's Risks table).

### Recommended next steps, in order

1. **Land Phase 3 next, in its own cut.** It's the biggest single change in the plan and the one that actually flips behavior. I'd suggest landing it in two sub-cuts to keep the diff reviewable:
   - 3a: Add `Provider.ApplyAtRunEnd` to the agent-manager sandbox seam + `workspace_sandbox.go` adapter + tests for the wire call. No run-executor changes yet.
   - 3b: Replace `tryAutoApproval` with `applyAtRunEnd` at a single shared call site after the terminal handlers in `Execute()`, add eager provenance write, wire `RunOutcome.ToContract`, remove the legacy fields, update proto + the orchestration test fixtures, write the 6 plan-specified test cases.

2. **Coordinate with `execute/gct-pending-ai-provenance-hardening` before Phase 5.** The schema-version contract is supposed to be a *shared* package between this item and the upstream one. Worth a quick sync to confirm the schema-version constant location and field names match what they expect to consume, before I write code that the reader side then has to adapt to.

3. **Phase 4 (GC) can land in parallel with 3 or after.** It's self-contained — a new branch in `LifecycleReconciler.ReconcileLifecycle` consuming `ManualReviewTTL`. Low risk, modest test surface (clock-injected TTL expiry).

4. **Defer the proto regen and spawn-surface `ConversationID` population to follow-up items.** They're in scope for the plan but cross-cut other repos and aren't blockers — the inheritance fallback I shipped covers the gap.

5. **When Phase 3 lands, remove the deprecation comments** I left on `SandboxAcceptanceConfig.AutoApprove` / `AutoReject` / `DisableAutoApproveIfEmpty` and `RunConfig.RequiresApproval`. They're load-bearing for `tryAutoApproval` today; once that path is gone, they're dead.

6. **Don't merge what's here yet** unless you specifically want to ship the seam-only state. The agent-manager Run model now has `ConversationID` / `ParentRunID` columns and the workspace-sandbox API has a new endpoint — both are forward-compatible, but neither does anything observable end-to-end without Phase 3. If you do merge, gate any operator-visible behavior on Phase 3 + the schema-version coordination landing.
"""

mutations.rationale: Feedback: agent only completed Phases 1–2; the in-review item should reflect that narrower scope so reviewers don't expect end-to-end behavior.

patch.title: Land workspace-sandbox apply-at-run-end seam (Phases 1–2 of auto-apply-defaults)
patch.description: Scope reduced to what actually shipped: domain types, the new `POST /api/v1/sandboxes/{id}/apply-at-run-end` endpoint, validation, audit annotations, schema-version-ready provenance fields, and unit tests. Legacy `tryAutoApproval` / `AutoApprove` / `AutoReject` / `DisableAutoApproveIfEmpty` / `RequiresApproval` fields remain in place as deprecated. Run-executor wiring, GC, schema-version package, and the headline run-executor tests are tracked as separate items (Phase 3a, Phase 3b, Phase 4, Phase 5). Do not merge operator-visible behavior on this item alone — it is forward-compatible but observable only once Phase 3b lands.

mutations.rationale: Execution agent recommended landing Phase 3 in two sub-cuts; 3a is the reviewable wire-level prerequisite with no behavior flip.

item.name: agent-manager-apply-at-run-end-provider-seam
item.title: Add Provider.ApplyAtRunEnd seam on agent-manager + workspace_sandbox adapter (Phase 3a)
item.description: Add `Provider.ApplyAtRunEnd` to the agent-manager sandbox provider seam, implement it in the `workspace_sandbox.go` adapter against the new `POST /api/v1/sandboxes/{id}/apply-at-run-end` endpoint, and cover the wire call with adapter tests. No run-executor behavior change yet — this is the wire-level prerequisite for Phase 3b. Locked contract reference: `scenarios/swarm-manager/research/agent-sandbox-auditability-contract`.

mutations.rationale: Phase 3b is the behavior-flipping cut; isolating it keeps the diff reviewable and gives a single clear merge gate for downstream rollout/e2e items.

item.name: agent-manager-run-executor-apply-at-run-end-cutover
item.title: Cut run executor over to applyAtRunEnd and remove legacy auto-approval fields (Phase 3b)
item.description: Replace `tryAutoApproval` with a single shared `applyAtRunEnd` call site after the terminal handlers in `Execute()`. Add the eager provenance write at sandbox setup, wire `RunOutcome.ToContract` (7→4 mapping), remove the deprecated legacy fields (`SandboxAcceptanceConfig.AutoApprove` / `AutoReject` / `DisableAutoApproveIfEmpty`, `RunConfig.RequiresApproval`), update proto + generated code, fix `orchestration/sandbox_config_test.go` fixtures, and write the six plan-specified run-executor test cases (success-apply, failure-apply, partial-acceptance split, manualReview-deferred, no-op empty-provenance, ConversationID inheritance). This is the load-bearing cut that flips behavior end-to-end. Locked contract reference: `scenarios/swarm-manager/research/agent-sandbox-auditability-contract`.

item.name: workspace-sandbox-manual-review-ttl-gc
item.title: Implement manualReview TTL GC in LifecycleReconciler (Phase 4)
item.description: Wire `ManualReviewTTL` (already present on `LifecycleConfig`, env var `WORKSPACE_SANDBOX_MANUAL_REVIEW_TTL`) into `LifecycleReconciler.ReconcileLifecycle` so abandoned `manualReview=true` sandboxes are auto-denied on TTL expiry instead of leaking indefinitely. Clock-injected TTL expiry test required. Self-contained; can land in parallel with or after Phase 3.

mutations.rationale: Plan's Phase 5 explicitly requires cross-initiative coordination; tracking it as its own item makes the dependency on the GCT branch visible.

item.description: Per Decision 3 in the locked plan, the schema-version contract is meant to be a shared package between this initiative and `execute/gct-pending-ai-provenance-hardening` (currently on a different branch). Coordinate field names + schema-version constant location with that item before persisting `runOutcome` / `state` / `conversationId` / `costUsd` end-to-end. Until this lands, the wire-level fields added in Phases 1–2 are not persisted and readers see empty values.
